overview.heading: One airframe. Every mission.
paragraphs: The U15 is a 15 kg-class quadcopter built to change roles without changing aircraft. Swap the sensor pod, the cargo box or the water sampler, and the same platform flies inspection rounds, drops supplies or collects environmental samples.

A 1,300 mm wheelbase folds into 455 × 630 × 540 mm for transport. Unfolded, it delivers 75 minutes of endurance with no payload and 31 minutes at the full 15 kg. Tethered power keeps it on station around the clock.
Dual radar, 360° lidar on the Pro edition and IP55 sealing let it work in rain, dust and darkness, from -20 °C to 50 °C, up to a 5,000 m service ceiling.

pod.heading: Four sensors on one stabilised gimbal

editions.heading: Standard or Pro
editions.intro: Same airframe, same payload. The difference is what the aircraft can compute and perceive on its own.
editions.kit: Aircraft × 1 · ES15 battery × 2 · remote controller × 1 · charger × 1 · trolley case × 1 · 1-year control platform · third-party liability insurance × 1 year · lightweight AI model · 6 TOPS compute module.

items.a: Up to 15 kg on the standard airframe. Twelve payloads share the same quick-release bay, including the four-sensor gimbal pod, logistics box, searchlight, loudspeaker, parachute, methane telemeter, water flow velocimeter, gas detector and an airborne emergency communications station.

items.q: How long can the U15 stay airborne?
items.a: 75 minutes with no payload, 54 minutes at 5 kg, 41 minutes at 10 kg and 31 minutes at the full 15 kg. With a mooring box providing tethered power, the aircraft can stay on station continuously.
The direct link reaches 15 km in unobstructed, interference-free conditions. The Pro edition adds 4G/5G cloud control for operations beyond that range, subject to local approvals.

items.q: Can it fly in rain and wind?
items.a: Yes. The airframe is IP55 rated against dust, sand and rain, operates from -20 °C to 50 °C, and is rated for level-6 winds with gusts to level 7.

items.q: What separates the Standard and Pro editions?
items.a: Onboard compute rises from 6 TOPS to 67 TOPS, the AI model moves from lightweight to medium precision, obstacle avoidance moves from four-direction laser to 360° lidar plus millimetre-wave radar, and the Pro adds 4G/5G direct cloud control.

items.q: Can it deliver to a moving vehicle or a vessel?
items.a: Yes. Visual precision landing uses a calibration plate to absorb deck and vehicle motion and docks at centimetre level. Dynamic drops onto moving targets are supported in the delivery workflow.

items.q: Is the U15 approved for beyond visual line of sight?
items.a: Approval depends on your jurisdiction. Partdro supports operators with documentation and configuration choices, but the operator remains responsible for local permits and flight rules.

items.q: What is included in the standard kit?
items.a: One aircraft, two ES15 smart batteries, one remote controller, a charger, a trolley case, a one-year control platform licence, one year of third-party liability insurance and the lightweight AI model with a 6 TOPS compute module.

items.q: How do I get pricing and lead time?
items.a: Send the configuration, region and expected mission profile through the quote form on this page. Our team replies within one business day with pricing, lead time and shipping options.

notes.aria: Product usage notes and data conditions
intro: * Check, confirm and strictly comply with local laws and regulations before flying.
** All videos and images on this page were captured in compliance with applicable local regulations. Confirm the aircraft has the required permits before flying.
*** Product appearance is subject to the shipped unit. Please load within the weight status shown in the control app; otherwise flight safety may be affected.

items.text: 1. Endurance is measured at equivalent sea-level altitude, 25 °C ambient temperature and windless conditions, until the battery was depleted and a forced landing occurred. Results vary with environment, payload, usage and firmware.

2. The 15 km communication distance was measured outdoors in open, interference-free conditions and represents the maximum one-way, no-return distance. Watch return-to-home prompts in the app during actual flights.
3. The 5,000 m service ceiling requires high-altitude propeller blades. Payload capacity decreases as takeoff altitude increases; quoted payload figures are measured at sea level.
4. AI recognition, target tracking and terrain following are assistive functions. Operators remain responsible for flight safety and must monitor the environment at all times.
